title: Fern Balcony
description: A low falling phrase receives an almost canonic answer one bar later. The two voices share a narrow, warm register before the upper line opens out. A six-bar chromatic conversation changes the meaning of the return, which settles on an open D-minor seventh.
technical_note: Keep both lines equally vocal and distinguish their overlapping phrase endings. The middle-register upper melody must stay clear of the left hand. Use the rests as breaths; later dyads require a gentle top voice.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
